## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Cline #13521: Platform-native line endings for new files (MODERATE ~4h) **[ACTIONABLE]**

- **What**: The `write_file` tool now uses platform-native EOL (`os.EOL`) for new files instead of hardcoded `\n`. Prevents CRLF/LF mismatches on Windows where new files created by the agent had Unix line endings even though the project used Windows line endings, causing git diffs to show the entire file changed.
- **Why**: Cross-platform correctness - new files should match the platform's native EOL convention (`\r\n` on Windows, `\n` on Unix/Mac) to avoid spurious diffs and line-ending conflicts.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13521 (Cline #13521)
- **Category**: tool (write)
- **Size**: MODERATE ~4h (Alexi src/tool/tools/write.ts L1-100 hardcodes `\n` for all new files via `fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf-8')` where `content` is passed with `\n` line separators, should use `os.EOL` as default for new files + optionally detect/preserve existing file's EOL when overwriting - add helper `normalizeNewFileLineEndings(content: string): string` that replaces `\n` with `os.EOL`, apply in write.ts L80-90 before writeFileSync, add test coverage for Windows CRLF + Unix LF, ~4h pattern + tests).

#### 2. Cline #13525: Prevent search_codebase from crashing on giant single-line files (MODERATE ~6h) **[INVESTIGATE]**

- **What**: The `search_codebase` tool's ripgrep JSON mode handler buffered all of `rg --json` stdout into one string. Each JSON event embeds the full matched line (--max-columns is ignored in JSON mode), so searching directories with serialized trace dumps (single-line multi-hundred-MB JSON files) accumulated gigabytes of stdout until string concatenation threw `RangeError: Out of memory`, killing the process (uncaught exception outside tool try/catch). Now stops buffering past 10MB, drops trailing partial events before parsing, and truncates context lines to `MAX_LINE_CHARS`.
- **Why**: Defensive coding - tools should not be able to crash the process via OOM on legitimate project files (trace dumps, minified JS bundles, single-line JSON logs).
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13525 (Cline #13525)
- **Category**: tool (search)
- **Size**: MODERATE ~6h (Alexi src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts L1-500 uses ripgrep with `--json` mode and appears to buffer output - need to verify if same unbounded buffering exists; if yes, add 10MB stdout cap via stream size tracker + early abort, drop trailing partial JSON events, truncate context lines to 2000 chars, add test with giant single-line file; if codesearch already streams incrementally or has size limits, SKIP; investigation + fix ~6h pattern + tests IF vulnerable).

#### 3. Cline #13522: Hide per-tool MCP auto-approve checkboxes behind flag (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: VSCode webview UI change hiding per-tool MCP auto-approve checkboxes behind a feature flag `SHOW_MCP_PER_TOOL_AUTO_APPROVE=false`. The SDK approval path is all-or-nothing via the global "Use MCP servers" toggle, so the per-tool checkboxes were no-ops that implied control that doesn't exist. The flag preserves the checkbox components/handlers/RPC plumbing in case the SDK gains per-tool approval granularity later.
- **Why**: VSCode UI cleanup - remove no-op controls that confuse users.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13522 (Cline #13522)
- **Category**: mcp (UI)
- **Size**: LOW (VSCode webview UI feature, Alexi is CLI-only with NO MCP approval UI or per-tool approval policies - src/mcp/ has server lifecycle via src/mcp/client.ts + transport via src/mcp/transport.ts but MCP tools execute without approval gates currently, pattern only relevant if Alexi adds MCP approval system where users can gate tool execution per-tool or per-server, SKIP for now).

#### 5. Cline #13517: Carry root overrides into Node smoke-test sandbox (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: CI fix copying `package.json` overrides block into the smoke-test sandbox's generated package.json so `npm install` resolves the same pinned versions as the repo root. Without it, `@sap-cloud-sdk` 4.9.0 (released 2026-08-24) broke `@sap-ai-sdk/ai-api` 2.14.0 with `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`, failing CI even though the root pins `@sap-cloud-sdk/*` to 4.6.0.
- **Why**: Build/CI resilience - smoke tests should respect root dependency pins so third-party releases can't break them independently.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13517 (Cline #13517)
- **Category**: ci (build)
- **Size**: LOW (Cline CI/build infrastructure, Alexi CI does not have a smoke-test sandbox that needs root overrides copied, but good reminder to check `package.json` overrides are respected in all test environments - Alexi already pins `@sap-cloud-sdk` in root package.json, SKIP for feature work).

#### 6. Cline #13516: Cap hub-events db size so it can't fill the disk (MODERATE/SKIP - deferred)

- **What**: Hub durable event log could fill the disk - row/time retention alone didn't bound disk usage because envelopes carrying full session snapshots reach hundreds of KB each, retained rows could total tens of GB, sweeps only ran hourly, and `DELETE` never shrinks a SQLite file. Now enforces a 64 MiB size budget in `prune()` (oldest rows first, `VACUUM` to return space), and also prunes after every 16 MiB appended so bursts can't outrun the hourly timer. Also tolerates `VACUUM` failure on full disk and counts size budget in UTF-8 bytes not characters.
- **Why**: Defensive infrastructure - durable append-only logs must enforce size budgets or risk filling the disk and killing the daemon.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13516 (Cline #13516)
- **Category**: tool (infrastructure/observability)
- **Size**: MODERATE ~8h (Alexi has NO durable event log or hub mode yet - src/utils/telemetry.ts L1-65 is an in-memory stub with comment "in a production system this would send to a telemetry service", but pattern is valuable IF Alexi adds persistent telemetry/session log with SQLite: same disk-fill risk applies to any append-only log of session snapshots, need size budget (64 MiB reasonable), prune on interval AND after N MiB appended, VACUUM to reclaim space, count UTF-8 bytes not characters; defer until observability strategy decided and persistent log implementation chosen, SKIP for now).

#### 7. Cline #13352: Resolve hook workspace identity from window not global state (MODERATE/SKIP - deferred)

- **What**: Hook discovery, hook cwd selection, and the `workspaceRoots` metadata passed to hook scripts all read `workspaceRoots` / `primaryRootIndex` keys from VS Code global state (`~/.cline`, shared by all windows/CLI/JetBrains). Nothing writes these keys anymore, so hooks resolved against whatever project some other or older instance last recorded. With a second window open on another project, a workspace's `.clinerules/hooks` scripts were never discovered. Now resolves workspace roots via a single guarded helper backed by `HostProvider.workspace.getWorkspacePaths()` (in-process, window-scoped), blank paths filtered, host-bridge failure degrades to no workspace roots instead of silently disabling hooks, one resolution threaded through hooks-dir discovery / cache misses / cwd selection / hook input metadata so they can't disagree. Roots and hooks dirs matched on whole path segments with longest root winning.
- **Why**: Multi-window correctness - hooks should resolve to the workspace of the active window/session, not leak state from other windows or stale sessions.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13352 (Cline #13352)
- **Category**: tool (hooks/infrastructure)
- **Size**: MODERATE ~8h (Alexi src/hooks/ reads hook config from `.alexi/hooks/` (global) or `<workdir>/.alexi/hooks/` (project-scoped) with NO multi-window shared state - CLI sessions are single-workdir, each invocation resolves hooks once at session start based on `process.cwd()` or `--workdir`, so multi-window/multi-project confusion does not exist in current single-session CLI model; but same pattern applies IF Alexi adds daemon mode or persistent hub where multiple concurrent sessions could run different projects simultaneously - hooks should resolve per-session workdir not global state, need per-session workspace root tracking + longest-match resolution for nested workspaces; defer until daemon/hub lands, SKIP for now).
